name: Lodge Seasoned Cast Iron 6-Well Muffin Pan
description: Lodge seasoned cast iron muffin pan with six wells. The brand page says it is seasoned with vegetable oil and made without PFAS. The Amazon description says the same. The pan is oven safe and not recommended for the stovetop.
features: Amazon ASIN B0BFRZD21Q is the 6-well pan, part BW6MFN. A special-feature field says made without PFOA or PTFE. The product description says it is a tin made without PFAS and seasoned with 100 percent vegetable oil.

Lodge's muffin-pan page says the pan is made in the USA, has six wells, is seasoned with 100 percent natural vegetable oil, and is made without PFAS. It says the pan is oven safe and not recommended for stovetop use.
Those are Lodge's claims. This directory has not tested the pan.
labelNote: Made without PFAS is Lodge's sentence for this pan. Seasoning is vegetable oil. This directory has not tested the iron.
